title: Refactor engraver rendering from vello::Scene to anyrender PaintScene
description:
## Discovery

Analysis shows anyrender PaintScene trait is a near-perfect 1:1 match for every vello::Scene method the engraver uses. Migration is feasible with low risk.

## Gap Analysis

### Direct 1:1 Mappings (no changes needed):
- fill() -> PaintScene::fill()
- stroke() -> PaintScene::stroke()
- draw_glyphs() -> PaintScene::draw_glyphs()
- push_layer() / pop_layer() -> identical
- reset() -> identical

### One Gap: Scene::append()
The cached scene compositing pattern (scene.append(&cached, Some(transform))) has no PaintScene equivalent. anyrender has append_scene() but it takes anyrender::Scene, not vello::Scene. Options:
1. Keep scene_mut() as a Vello-specific escape hatch for the caching hot path only
2. Record the engraver output as anyrender::Scene instead of vello::Scene
3. Upstream a backend-agnostic scene append to anyrender

## Files to Modify

1. engraver-proto/src/engraver/renderer/scene_renderer.rs - Change VelloSceneRenderer to render through &mut impl PaintScene instead of &mut vello::Scene
2. engraver-proto/src/engraver/renderer/cursor_renderer.rs - Change signature from &mut Scene to &mut impl PaintScene (only uses fill/stroke)
3. keyflow-ui/src/chart_renderer.rs - Update ChartLayoutManager to use PaintScene for rendering, keep cached scene pattern via scene_mut()
4. fts-control/desktop/src/chart_graphics.rs - Already uses anyrender, just needs scene_mut() for append (currently broken without local fork patch)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] VelloSceneRenderer renders through PaintScene trait instead of direct vello::Scene
- [ ] cursor_renderer uses PaintScene trait methods
- [ ] chart_renderer updated to use PaintScene
- [ ] chart_graphics.rs compiles without local anyrender fork
- [ ] No direct vello::Scene usage outside the caching escape hatch
- [ ] cargo check -p engraver-proto passes
- [ ] cargo check -p keyflow-ui passes
- [ ] cargo check -p fts-control-desktop passes

## Context
Discovered while fixing build errors - chart_graphics.rs calls painter.scene_mut() which only exists in the local anyrender fork (reference/anyrender), not upstream. Rather than patching, we should abstract away the vello dependency properly.

Estimated effort: ~2 hours. Mostly signature changes, no logic rewrites.

title: US-010: Implement figue-based keymap config loading (Styx-first)
description:
Load input keymap configuration using figue, with Styx as the preferred source format while still allowing figue-supported JSON/Facet inputs.

**IMPORTANT**: Read `modules/actions/AGENTS.md` before starting. Prefer figue-driven parsing and avoid direct TOML-only assumptions.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Add `figue` dependency for input config loading (workspace/path as appropriate)
- [ ] Define `KeymapConfig` in `src/config.rs` with a schema that can be decoded via figue
- [ ] Implement Styx-first loading path for default keymaps (and compatible JSON/Facet decoding through figue)
- [ ] Parse mode definitions into `ModeDefinition`
- [ ] Parse keymap bindings into trie entries (single-key + multi-key sequences)
- [ ] Parse leaf directives: `mode:<id>`, `operator:<name>`, `motion:<name>`, `textobj:<name>`, `unbind`, and action IDs
- [ ] Parse context-qualified keymap overlays and map to `WhenExpr`
- [ ] Parse mouse bindings and map to `MousePattern`
- [ ] Implement `InputProcessor::from_config(config) -> Self`
- [ ] Add tests for config decode, keymap decode, context overlays, mouse bindings, and end-to-end process flow
- [ ] Review /Users/codywright/Documents/Development/Rust/rust-best-practices/ for error handling patterns
- [ ] `cargo test -p input` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy -p input -- -D warnings` passes
close_reason: Implemented figue-oriented keymap config pipeline with Styx-first API in input: added src/config.rs (KeymapConfig, mode/key/mouse/context parsing helpers, from_styx_str/from_json_str/from_path), parse directives for mode/operator/motion/textobj/unbind/action, mouse pattern decoding, and when-expression parsing integration. Added InputProcessor::from_config(config) wiring keymaps, context overlays, and mouse bindings. Added config-focused unit tests including end-to-end decode+process flow. Verified cargo test -p input and cargo clippy -p input -- -D warnings.

title: US-012: Implement macro recording and playback
description:
Add named-register macro recording that captures and replays input sequences.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Define `MacroRecorder` in `src/macros.rs`: 26 registers (a-z) + last-executed (@)
- [ ] `start_recording(register)`, `stop_recording()`, `record(chord)`, `play(register) -> Option<Vec<KeyChord>>`, `is_recording()`
- [ ] Integrate into InputProcessor: `q` + register starts recording, `q` stops
- [ ] `@` + register plays back, `@@` repeats last played
- [ ] Count prefix: `3@a` plays 3 times
- [ ] Playback feeds chords back through InputProcessor::process()
- [ ] Recursive prevention: do not record during playback
- [ ] Unit test: record jjj, play back produces 3x down actions
- [ ] Unit test: 3@a produces actions 3 times
- [ ] Unit test: @@ replays last register
- [ ] Unit test: recording during playback is ignored
- [ ] `cargo test -p input` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy -p input -- -D warnings` passes
close_reason: Implemented MacroRecorder + InputProcessor macro controls (@, @@, count prefix), playback recursion guard, and tests; cargo test/clippy for input passing.

title: US-013: Create input-dioxus bridge crate
description:
Create the Dioxus integration crate that converts DOM events to InputEvent types.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Create `modules/actions/input-dioxus/Cargo.toml` with deps: `input` (workspace), `dioxus` (workspace), `actions-keybindings` (workspace)
- [ ] Add `"modules/actions/input-dioxus"` to workspace members in root Cargo.toml
- [ ] Move `dioxus_key_to_keycode()` from `apps/fts-control/desktop/src/main.rs` into `src/convert.rs` (rename to `convert_key`)
- [ ] Move `dioxus_modifiers()` from main.rs into `src/convert.rs` (rename to `convert_modifiers`)
- [ ] Implement `convert_keyboard_event(e) -> Option<InputEvent>` — None for unrecognized keys
- [ ] Implement `convert_mouse_event(e, action: MouseAction) -> InputEvent`
- [ ] Implement `convert_wheel_event(e) -> InputEvent`
- [ ] `src/lib.rs` re-exports all conversion functions

- [ ] `cargo clippy -p input-dioxus -- -D warnings` passes

title: US-014: Implement use_input_processor Dioxus hook
description:
Create a Dioxus hook managing InputProcessor lifecycle, timeouts, and reactive state.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Define `InputHandle` struct in `src/hook.rs`
- [ ] `use_input_processor(config: KeymapConfig) -> InputHandle`
- [ ] `InputHandle::handle_key(e) -> Vec<InputCommand>` — convert + process
- [ ] `InputHandle::handle_mouse(e, action) -> Vec<InputCommand>`
- [ ] `InputHandle::handle_wheel(e) -> Vec<InputCommand>`
- [ ] `current_mode() -> ModeId` — reactive, triggers re-render
- [ ] `pending_display() -> Option<String>` — reactive, for status bar
- [ ] `is_recording() -> bool` — reactive, for recording indicator
- [ ] Timeout management: spawn delayed task when needs_timeout() returns Some
- [ ] Reads ActionContext from ACTION_CONTEXT global signal

- [ ] `cargo clippy -p input-dioxus -- -D warnings` passes
close_reason: Implemented input-dioxus use_input_processor hook with InputHandle, reactive mode/pending/recording signals, ACTION_CONTEXT global signal, and timeout scheduling; cargo check/clippy pass.

title: US-015: Integrate InputProcessor into fts-control desktop
description:
Wire the input system into the desktop app, replacing ActionDispatcher keyboard handling.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Replace `build_action_dispatcher()` in main.rs with InputProcessor setup using default KeymapConfig
- [ ] Embedded default keymap maps all existing shortcuts: Space=toggle_playback, L=toggle_loop, Right=smart_next, Left=smart_previous, Down=next_song, Up=previous_song (tab:performance context)
- [ ] Map standalone shortcuts: Cmd+Comma=open_settings, Cmd+Shift+D=toggle_dark_mode, Cmd+Shift+P=command_palette
- [ ] Replace `handle_keyboard_shortcut()` with InputHandle dispatch loop
- [ ] Route InputCommand::Action -> handler map, SwitchMode -> ACTION_CONTEXT, Pending -> status display, Unhandled -> no prevent_default
- [ ] Preserve F5-F9 dock preset handling
- [ ] All existing keyboard shortcuts work identically
- [ ] Add mode indicator display (status bar or overlay)
- [ ] `cargo build -p fts-control-desktop` succeeds
close_reason: Integrated InputProcessor/InputHandle into fts-control desktop, replaced ActionDispatcher keyboard path, preserved F5-F9 dock presets, routed InputCommands to handlers/context, added mode/pending overlay, and added Cmd+Shift+P command palette showing actions and mappings; cargo build -p fts-control-desktop passes.

title: US-002: Implement KeyTrie data structure
description:
Implement the trie data structure for efficient key sequence matching.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Define `KeyTrie` enum in `src/trie.rs`: `Leaf(LeafAction)`, `Node(TrieNode)`
- [ ] Define `TrieNode` struct: `name`, `sticky`, `children: HashMap<KeyChord, KeyTrie>`, `default`
- [ ] Define `LeafAction` enum: `Action(ActionId)`, `SwitchMode(ModeId)`, `PushMode(ModeId)`, `Operator(String)`, `Motion(String)`, `TextObject(String)`, `Sequence(Vec<ActionId>)`, `Unbind`
- [ ] Implement `TrieNode::new()`, `insert()`, `get()`, `merge()`
- [ ] Unit test: single-key binding lookup returns Leaf
- [ ] Unit test: two-key sequence (g g), first lookup returns Node, second returns Leaf
- [ ] Unit test: merge two tries, verify override behavior
- [ ] Unit test: sticky node flag preserved
- [ ] `cargo test -p input` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy -p input -- -D warnings` passes
close_reason: Implemented KeyTrie enum, TrieNode struct, LeafAction enum with all variants, insert/get/merge operations, and 12 unit tests. All 22 tests pass, clippy clean.

Implement the mode stack managing base editing modes and transient sticky sub-modes.

- [ ] `push()` adds sub-mode, `pop()` removes top (no-op if only 1 mode)

- [ ] Unit test: push/pop sub-mode works correctly
- [ ] Unit test: pop with single mode is no-op
- [ ] Unit test: switch_base clears sub-mode stack

- [ ] `SequenceState::new()`, `feed(chord, root) -> SequenceResult`, `timeout_expired()`, `is_pending()`, `pending_display()`, `reset()`
- [ ] Unit test: single key match returns Matched immediately
- [ ] Unit test: first key of two-key sequence returns Pending, second returns Matched
- [ ] Unit test: invalid key after pending returns NoMatch and resets
- [ ] Unit test: timeout on pending returns Timeout with accumulated keys

title: US-005: Implement InputProcessor core loop
description:
Build the main state machine tying together mode stack, trie lookup, sequence accumulation, and command output.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Define `InputProcessor` struct in `src/processor.rs`: owns ModeStack, per-mode keymaps, SequenceState, timeout config
- [ ] `new()` starts in Normal mode with empty keymaps
- [ ] `add_mode()`, `set_keymap()` for configuration
- [ ] `process(event: InputEvent, ctx: &ActionContext) -> Vec<InputCommand>` — main entry point
- [ ] Key events: look up current mode trie via SequenceState, translate to InputCommands
- [ ] Insert mode passthrough: unmatched character keys produce InsertText
- [ ] Escape: cancel pending sequence, pop sub-mode or switch to Normal
- [ ] `timeout_expired()`, `current_mode()`, `pending_display()`, `needs_timeout()`
- [ ] Unit test: single key action in normal mode
- [ ] Unit test: two-key sequence with pending state
- [ ] Unit test: mode switch via keybinding
- [ ] Unit test: insert mode passthrough produces InsertText
- [ ] Unit test: escape cancels pending and returns to normal

- [ ] `cargo clippy -p input -- -D warnings` passes

title: US-006: Implement context-aware keymap layers
description:
Add when-clause-qualified keymap overlays so the same key triggers different actions based on context.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Add `context_keymaps: HashMap<ModeId, Vec<(WhenExpr, TrieNode)>>` to InputProcessor
- [ ] `add_context_keymap(mode, when, root)` method
- [ ] During trie lookup: check context keymaps first (reverse order, first evaluating-true match wins), fall back to base
- [ ] Context keymaps use same TrieNode structure — support multi-key sequences
- [ ] Unit test: context override active returns context-specific action
- [ ] Unit test: context override inactive falls back to base keymap
- [ ] Unit test: multiple context layers, most recently added matching one wins
- [ ] `cargo test -p input` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy -p input -- -D warnings` passes
close_reason: Implemented context-aware keymap layers in InputProcessor: added context_keymaps HashMap<ModeId, Vec<(WhenExpr, TrieNode)>>, add_context_keymap(), reverse-order context lookup with fallback to base keymap, and multi-key support via trie lookup. Added tests for active override, inactive fallback, and most-recent matching layer precedence. Verified cargo test -p input and cargo clippy -p input -- -D warnings.

title: US-007: Implement prefix count accumulation
description:
Add numeric prefix support so users can type `3w` to mean "move forward 3 words".

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Add count accumulation state to InputProcessor
- [ ] Digit keys 1-9 as first input accumulate into count
- [ ] `0` as very first key is NOT a count (maps to line_start or whatever is bound)
- [ ] Subsequent `0` after other digits IS part of count (e.g., `10j`)
- [ ] Count resets after command completion or Escape
- [ ] Count passed through `InputArgs.count` (None when no prefix, not Some(1))
- [ ] Unit test: `3` then `w` -> count=Some(3)
- [ ] Unit test: `12` then `j` -> count=Some(12)
- [ ] Unit test: `0` alone -> bound action (not count)
- [ ] Unit test: `10` then `j` -> count=Some(10)
- [ ] Unit test: Escape clears pending count
- [ ] `cargo test -p input` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy -p input -- -D warnings` passes
close_reason: Implemented prefix count accumulation in InputProcessor: added count state, digit accumulation rules (1-9 start, leading 0 not count, subsequent 0 allowed), count reset on command completion and Escape, and count injection via InputArgs.count through ActionWithArgs. Added acceptance tests for 3w, 12j, 0 alone, 10j, and Escape clearing count. Verified cargo test -p input and cargo clippy -p input -- -D warnings.

title: US-008: Implement operator+motion composition
description:
Add Vim-style operator+motion composition so `dw` = delete word, `dd` = delete line, `3d2w` = delete 6 words.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Add CompositionState to InputProcessor: pending_operator, operator_count
- [ ] LeafAction::Operator stores operator, moves count to operator_count
- [ ] LeafAction::Motion with pending operator produces ActionWithArgs (operator + motion + combined count)
- [ ] Motion without operator produces ActionWithArgs with motion only
- [ ] Double-operator (dd, yy) produces operator + motion:"line"
- [ ] TextObject only valid after operator (diw = delete inner word)
- [ ] Escape cancels pending operator
- [ ] Unit test: `d` then `w` -> operator:delete, motion:word_forward
- [ ] Unit test: `3d2w` -> count:6, operator:delete, motion:word_forward
- [ ] Unit test: `dd` -> operator:delete, motion:line
- [ ] Unit test: `y3j` -> operator:yank, motion:down, count:3
- [ ] Unit test: Escape cancels pending `d`
- [ ] `cargo test -p input` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy -p input -- -D warnings` passes
close_reason: Implemented operator+motion composition in InputProcessor: added pending operator state, operator count tracking, motion/text-object composition, double-operator line motion (dd/yy), count multiplication (3d2w => 6), and Escape/unmatched cancellation. Added trie bind helpers for operator/motion/text_object and acceptance tests for dw, 3d2w, dd, y3j, and Escape cancelling pending operator. Verified cargo test -p input and cargo clippy -p input -- -D warnings.

title: US-009: Implement mouse event matching
description:
Add mouse event handling with modifier-aware pattern matching.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Define `MousePattern` struct in `src/mouse.rs`: button, action, modifiers
- [ ] Define `MouseBindingTable`: Vec<(MousePattern, WhenExpr, ActionId)>
- [ ] `insert()` and `match_event(event, ctx) -> Option<ActionId>` (first match wins, checks when-clause)
- [ ] Add `mouse_bindings: HashMap<ModeId, MouseBindingTable>` to InputProcessor
- [ ] InputProcessor handles InputEvent::Mouse via current mode mouse table
- [ ] Extend InputArgs with `position: Option<(f64, f64)>` and `scroll_delta: Option<(f64, f64)>`
- [ ] Unit test: left click matches Left+Down pattern
- [ ] Unit test: ctrl+click matches pattern with ctrl modifier
- [ ] Unit test: context-qualified mouse binding only matches when context active
- [ ] Unit test: unmatched mouse event returns Unhandled
- [ ] `cargo test -p input` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy -p input -- -D warnings` passes
close_reason: Implemented mouse event matching: added src/mouse.rs with MousePattern and MouseBindingTable (insert + context-aware first-match lookup), added mouse_bindings per mode to InputProcessor with add_mouse_binding(), wired InputEvent::Mouse handling via mode table, and extended InputArgs with position and scroll_delta fields. Added tests for left press, ctrl+click, context-qualified mouse binding, and unmatched mouse fallback. Verified cargo test -p input and cargo clippy -p input -- -D warnings.
